title: Search and Delete in a Trie: The Hidden Logic Behind Predictive Text
short_hook: Master Trie search and recursive deletion logic.
description:
Learn how to efficiently search for words and safely remove them from a Trie structure. Master the recursive cleanup process to preserve shared paths for other words like 'carpet' when deleting 'car'. In this lesson: Understanding the isEnd flag, Searching for a word by traversing the path, The recursive Delete algorithm and node removal rules, Handling shared nodes and prefixes, Real-world applications in autocomplete and IP routing. This is lesson 46 of our complete Data Structures & Algorithms course - watch the full playlist from the beginning.
